_patch.note: Metadata-only pass. No price moves. Adds a `vendor` field to every row and documents the difference from `provider`, because the two were being conflated and the dataset is advertised as groupable and citable.

meta.notes: Public list prices, not contract or batch/discounted rates. Verify against the provider before publishing; refresh the date when you reuse it.

fields.vendor: The company that makes the model. This is the field to group by. 23 distinct values across this snapshot, e.g. xAI, Meta, Anthropic, Zhipu.
fields.provider: How the model is reached or billed, and it is NOT one company per value. It carries API product lines ('OpenAI (legacy)', 'OpenAI embedding') and, historically, a hosting region ('US & EU' held Nova Pro, Llama 4 and the Grok models). Three values are OpenAI. Group by vendor instead; keep provider only if you want per-product-line or per-region cuts.
fields.priceInputPer1M: List price per 1,000,000 input tokens, USD.
fields.priceOutputPer1M: List price per 1,000,000 output tokens, USD.
fields.priceCachedInputPer1M: Cache-read price where the vendor publishes one. Absent means not published, not free.
fields.contextWindow: Advertised maximum context. Several vendors bill long context at a higher rate above a threshold; that threshold is in the model's note when it applies.
fields.tokenizer: 'tiktoken:<encoding>' means token counts are exact. 'estimate' means a calibrated character ratio, roughly 5-10% off.
fields.note: Editorial, per model. Dates, promotions and billing traps that a rate card hides.
